nom: Clinique Even Better Clinical Dark Spot Clearing Serum with Vitamin C

avis.titre: Don't be late to the party like me
avis.texte: Let me just say, I love this product! About 2 months ago I went to one of the Clinique in shop departments in South Africa, just for a casual skin scan tryout. The outcome showed noticeable uneven skin tone and pigmentation. I was recommended this product, in addition to the Smart Clinical Lifting Face and Neck Creme. I have never looked back! This product is gentle but effective. At month 2 I can definitely see the difference... clearer, brighter and smoother skin.

avis.titre: Best dark spot treatment on the market
avis.texte: I have tried different brands, some less expensive others more, Clinique is by far superior. Results are visible within a couple weeks. Because it is not greasy and absorbe fast, I can put my day cream within minutes.
I'm on my second bottle and am very pleased with how it makes my 69 yo skin feel and look. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Brightens and Evens Skin Over Time
avis.texte: I grew up on the Clinique 3-step skincare system and slowly expose myself to other Clinique skincare products. I started using this serum four and a half weeks ago and find that it absorbs fully and quickly into the skin after applying the Even Better Brightening Lotion. It has started to even the skin tone where my beard grows and I shave from time to time. Additionally, it instantly brightens my skin. Please apply sunscreen as a final step when using this product to prevent UV rays from undoing the brightening results. I gave this item four stars due to the length of time it takes to start to see results. Patience and consistency pay off though!

avis.titre: A brightening serum I keep repurchasing
avis.texte: This product works really well. I've been using it for several years now, and my skin has actually gotten lighter. My face is now lighter than my neck, so I've recently started using it on my neck as well. The niacinamide and salicylic acid in it work great—I feel like they also help clear up acne. I'll definitely keep buying this.
I've been using this for a couple of weeks now. I'm just starting to see results.

avis.titre: Yes I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: Pleasantly surprised how fast it worked. In six weeks the dark spots on my cheeks faded 60% Very happy with this product.

avis.titre: Didn't make much difference in my dark spots
avis.texte: Been using this twice a day for months now to lighten some dark spots on my face Haven't noticed too much of a difference especially on one bigger spot It has lightened it a bit but it's still very noticeable without makeup Gave this over a few months & have used most of the bottle but sadly it hasn't done much

I have a dime size light brown age spot on my cheek. Dermatologist suggested laser treatment but the office didn't have the equipment. I was going to go to another dermatologist to get this taken care of but I figure I'll try this serum. I followed the instructions exactly. Didn't see any results for the first 2 weeks but I kept at it. After about 4 weeks, I noticed that the spot got a little lighter. I continued and after another 2 weeks (total of 6 weeks), I definitely noticed that it was fading! I'm impressed that the serum worked. I'll continue to use it until it's completely gone. I recommend this product but you must have patience to see results.

I bought this Clinical dark spot serum about a month ago and have been using it twice a day. I noticed that the dark spot area has lightened pretty much and I don't have to use my correcting cream concealer. I'm very pleased and will continue to use. Very important to use high SPF sunscreen daily prior to foundation.
Visible dark spot reduction and a more even skin tone in one bottle.
It worked really good for the dark spot that was on my forehead.
I have dark spots on my forehead from years of tanning in my 20s. I have been using this for about two months and have noticed a huge improvement! Happy with results and will buy again.

avis.titre: Can't cont. to buy Clinique Even Better Dark Spot serum
avis.texte: Loved this for yrs & was VERY happy w/the results. New & "improved" serum has been changed to now make ZERO difference for me. So much so I am getting asked when did I get these spots. I have pics I see the stark change. Now on the hunt for another.
It lightens the brown spots on my hands some. It's the best I have found so far.

avis.titre: I didn't have any positive effect
avis.texte: I didn't have any positive effect, and it ended very quickly.

I absolutely love clinique and thought I'd give this a try. It is pricey but worth it if it works. I have only tried it for a week so I have not seen results yet. I'm expecting to see them about 1 month.

I struggled with acne scars and this product really helped clearing my face. I used to combine it with the moisture surge cream by clinic to lock it in for longer time on the face. It gives glow as well and it doesnt have strong smell. I highly recommend not only for acne , it has vitamin c it great for face for healthy looking face. Its a bit pricely but the container last because you only need two pumps.

Niacinamide is one of the first ingredients in this formula, a top-tier skincare ingredient for reducing hyperpigmentation. One has to wait at least 3 months, or one skin cycle, for any noticeable improvement, which is normal, as any dermatologist will tell you. I need to wait until there is another sale to stock up.

avis.titre: Love the results, change the bottle
avis.texte: I love the results of this serum. Helps tremendously with dark spots. While the bottle looks cool, the larger version is NOT TSA friendly...the bottle looks larger than 100ml on the screening machines.
I like this serum which makes my skin more smooth and bright. My friends recommended this to me, and I agree with her.

I have a dark spot under my left eye that was about the size of a dime. After using this serum 2-3 times a day for 2 weeks straight, the color faded at least 50%. The way I use this is, first I apply a layer all over my face, then I put a small dab on my ring finger and tap the serum directly on the dark spot and keep tapping gently for 30 seconds to ensure the serum is well asborbed. Really, really happy with my results and would definitely recommend this!
I've used this for years. I'm fair and have developed spots on the face. This doesn't make the spots disappear, but it's the best I've found to keep them controlled and fade over time.
I used this previously and was thrilled! Sun spots faded. I repurchased again and it's done nothing. Have been using for months. Bring back the old version, this is too expensive to waste money on!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Clinique is definitely a girls girl when it comes to this packaging! And the product is amazing too! It makes my skin feel hydrated immediately and over time with consistent use, I noticed some of my dark spots fading.
It was updated from the last time I purchased it and what a difference. Already a great product and now it is even better at getting ride of wrinkles and fine lines. Thank you Clinique.
I used this for 4 months in the AM and PM and saw no changes in my sun spots/dark spots. I was really disappointed as this was the first time trying it and I use so many of your other products.

I'm a user of the original one but this updated/newer version really aids in brightening skin faster than the old one. Dark spots fading faster. Makes skin softer too. A better brightener plus moisturizer in one.
Created bumps and acne on my face. Gave it a month but no luck. Too expensive to not do as it says it would do.

I recently started getting a few spots on my face. I thought I would try this product. I have only been using this for a couple of weeks and see the difference. The spots have lightened up. My skin seems to be a little smoother as well. I put it on twice a day and use dramatically moisturizer with it.
I've been using this product for 4 months now and have noticed any changes. But I'll keep using it.

avis.titre: Disappointed, No Results After Consistent use
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this serum, but unfortunately, it didn't work for me. I used it exactly as directed for a year, hoping to see even a slight improvement in my not so dark spots but there was no noticeable difference. The texture and scent were fine, and it didn't irritate my skin, but it also didn't deliver on its main promise. For the price, I expected at least some visible results. Sadly, this one just didn't live up to the hype.
I was excited to use this product and applied twice a day for three months with no improvement. Very disappointed since this was an expensive purchase.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I didn't really help my dark spots.. i do have some issues which hyperpigmentation and sun spots because i do tan and there wasn't much results from using it for a month.

avis.titre: Is not what they said it is.
avis.texte: This is disappointing, I did not see any changes for 3 months ,I bought the big bottled and is expensive I regret buying it

I tried this product and was very disappointed. The previous generation of the product is much better (the interruptor) very disappointed in Clinique because I have wasted my money. And these products are expensive. The new generation has niacinimide. My skin does not do well with niacinimide. The previous generation does not contain it. Make me re-think ordering from Clinique. Long time customer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this for a few weeks now and I can already tell a difference in my skin tone. Some of my dark spots are starting to fade, and my face just looks a little more even overall. It goes on smooth and doesn't feel heavy or sticky. I wasn't expecting magic overnight, but so far, it's doing exactly what I hoped it would. Definitely sticking with it for now.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The bottle and packaging is beautiful, the product goes on smooth, is not greasy, not too thick, and absorbs amazingly. My skin looked brighter and better with it. I highly recommend it. It's worth every penny.
I've been using this over a month and I haven't seen any results I'm very disappointed as it was recommended by young women in Ulta that it would improve or remove my dark spots
I have been using this product for a month now. There is absolutely no change in my dark spots. I am very disappointed.
This is the 3rd time I have contacted the company and received so satisfaction. Either quickly resolve the problem or refund my account.

avis.titre: Not as good as the old formula
avis.texte: I have been using Even Better Dark Spot Corrector or Clearing Serum for years and this new formula does not work nearly as well as the old one. It does not seem to fade my dark spots at all. So disappointed that after all these years that I have to look for another product that works.
I have been using the Dark Spot Corrector for about a year, There is a dramatic difference! I love this product.
False advertisement. Been using for over 3 months and does not remove dark spots. It made them worst and more noticeable. Not good at Ll.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm 49 and have struggled with dark spots my entire life. This silky-feeling serum made such a difference in my face. I love the pump bottle. It's easy to fit into my skincare routine and brightens Hyperpigmentation and soothes skin!
I tried the serum for a few weeks consistently but I didn't see much difference

avis.titre: Great for sun spots, dark spots and uneven skin tone!
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review! Definitely a must for dark spots, sun damage or uneven skin tone! Super soft on the skin, it layers well with other products! It can fit in with all of your other skincare products. It really helps diminish dark spots after using it for a few weeks! The package is a pump style and very easy to use and has a minimal scent which is perfect! Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Works on stubborn dark marks for black girls
avis.texte: This product has changed my life for the better. I promise it's worth the investment. I used so many products that did absolutely nothing, but I stayed consistent. This product along with other clinique skincare products has increasingly over the past 2 months helped with lightening my dark spots. It does take time, so take pics to track your progress & add your little bit of concealer for now. But it works!
This stuff is AMAZING. It feels so good on the skin. It's just applies perfectly. The way my skin feels after this is amazing as well! The scent isn't super strong which I love.
After three bottles of this product, I gave up. There was absolutely no improvement in the dark spots on my face. Wish I could find something that really works.
I have struggled with dark spots my whole life, this product is like liquid gold to me! Dark spots are getting better, at first I didn't think it would work but surprise surprise!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. The serum was lightweight and not scented, making it great for daily wear. It was hydrating and not sticky. You need one pump and use it daily to see results. I noticed my skin was brighter, but nothing worked on a brown sunspot.

Absolutely loving this serum from Clinique! It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin super soft and hydrated. After a few weeks, I noticed a visible glow and smoother texture. Perfect for layering and gentle on my sensitive skin. Definitely a new staple in my skincare routine!

i did enjoy how hydrated my skin felt with this product but i didnt truly notice a different with discoloration. it has great ingredients and the scent and packaging are great, but it isn't something i'd repurchase since i didnt notice a true difference.
I received this product for free from Influenster. I loved everything about it. The packaging, The ease of use. The feel of the product were all awesome.

It was nice and lightweight. I was able to put this under makeup and there was no issues. As far as the dark spot correction, it is still there. I guess I have to use it more than a month to see a noticeable change.
Packaging has a luxurious look. Product smells nice and texture is smooth when applying to the skin. Did see a bit of improvement so feel the product is effective.

I am glad to discover this next generation vrrsion of the Even Better serum. It goes on easily, giving the skin a smooth texture and a healthy glow. Having used previous versions of this serum with results following consistent use, I have high expectations for this "Even Better" version of this serum.
Love this serum! Must use consistently to see results. It makes your skin glow and helps with fading. Just be careful using it too close to your eyes.
This did absolutely nothing for me. It did give a little glow to my skin but no reduction in dark spots. And after a few hours my face turned extremely oily.
Clinique Even Better Clinical Dark Spot Corrector is lightweight & hydrating. It fades spots over time, but consistency is key pretty packaging ! #Influenster

This clinique dark spot serum is really the truth! I have always been so insecure about my dark spots on my face but this + sunscreen helped to even out my dark spots and clear my face up in as little as 2 weeks! My only thing though is it can't be used near the eyes or else it will burn them so be careful.
It does what it says it does! I will say it took a bit longer than I was expecting to see a difference, but nonetheless I did end up seeing a little difference.

Wow! I have always enjoyed Clinique products and their effectiveness and this is no exception. The packaging feels nice and sturdy and the texture of the product isn't too thick or thin. There is no heavy scent and i have enjoyed each use. I will be repurchasing this when I finish.

avis.titre: Works great on my sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I've been using the Clinique Dark Spot Serum twice a day, applying it on my face before my moisturizer, and it has quickly become a staple in my new skincare routine. It's been perfect for targeting my sun damage and dark spots, and I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's overall tone. I love that it's fragrance-free, making it gentle even for sensitive skin, and its lightweight texture absorbs easily without feeling heavy or greasy.

This product is highly recommended. I didn't have any expectations, but loved the texture and the smell. The texture is not gooey now sticky, leaves you face hydrated writhing being sticky. There is a neutral smell to it, which I like. The packaging is really cute with the bottle. I would definitely but this product again.

I was pleasantly surprised at how well this cream worked on some dark spots that I had on my cheeks. I used this twice a day as directed, in the morning and in the evening before my moisturizer, and it lightened up some dark spots that I've had from sun damage. They are not completely gone after two weeks but they are reduced to the point that I don't even need to put concealer on them any more. The formula is light with a nice slip to it. It was completely absorbed and didn't leave behind any crazy residue.
I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I love it!! Visibly lightens and evens my skintone. Reduces pores.. I would definitely recommend

My mother-in-law has been using the Clinique Even Better Clinical Dark Spot Corrector for a few months now, and she's really happy with the results. The serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly without any sticky residue, which she appreciates. While it didn't make her dark spots disappear overnight, she's definitely noticed a more even skin tone and a nice brightness to her complexion. It hasn't irritated her skin, which can be sensitive to some brightening products. It's a bit pricey, but she feels it's worth it with consistent use.

Product seems to work with regular use. I removed a star for packaging - while it's beautiful and feels high end, it's glass. Most bathrooms are hard surfaces (tile, marble…) and for a product that costs the much to risk hitting the floor or skin and smashing…I just didn't think it was a great idea…I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

The texture of the serum is nice and it absorbs quickly. It's been a couple of weeks and I'm not sure I've noticed any difference, but my hyperpigmentation is not severe and the main ingredient is Vitamin C, which historically is not super effective for tone correcting for me.

avis.titre: Reduced dark spots after first couple uses!
avis.texte: This product was effective after one week! I was very happy with the the ingredients and the ease of the packaging. The texture is like a gel but not sticky at all. It soaked right into the skin. There was not much of a scent which I loved.

The first thing I noticed about this product is how beautiful the packaging is. Of course, that doesn't mean it will be effective. I used it according to the directions for the duration of my trial and I did not really notice a difference in the appearance of my dark spots. I did, however, like how it left my face feeling.

While i can't speak to the brightening benefits, because that'll take months, i do enjoy using this product. I like it's creamy/milky texture & it's promising benefits(patented ingredient is intriguing)!

I've received this item complimentary for my honest review. I've only been using this dark spot corrector for a few weeks and not every night because I also use Tretinoin… so it's hard to say if it's been making a difference or not as I'm actively breaking out. I haven't noticed it to break my skin out any more than usual though. I have very sensitive skin and this doesn't seem to do any damage. I like the simple packaging and that it's easy to apply. It applies smoothly. I don't think it's overpriced for what it is. Hopefully this will work well in conjunction with my skin routine over time. But only time will tell.

The product packaging is sleek and well designed but I did not notice any difference. I did try this on a keloid scar for fun and it actually made them worse. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

This serum goes on smoothly and immediately absorbs into your skin. I didn't detect any fragrance at all. The pump makes the product easy to dispense in small amounts which is all you need as a little goes a long way. I have some acne scarring and it did lighten it a little. I will keep using to see if the scars get lighter over time.

I am thrilled with the effectiveness of this product to lighten dark areas on my face. Not only is it surprisingly potent, but it also comes housed in an aesthetically pleasing iridescent glass bottle, intensifying its luxurious feel. The texture is another highlight, being incredibly smooth and feather-light on the skin. Its lack of substantial fragrance further refines the user experience, especially for those sensitive to strong scents. One thing I particularly value is that this product is dermatologist-developed. This reassures me that the ingredients used are safe for my skin. I can not recommend it enough for its superior quality and effective results. It's truly a standout product in the skincare market!

I love the packaging. Very sleek. It's easy to use. The spot I put it on wasn't the right kind maybe. I didn't see any change. I ended up getting the spot removed by my dermatologist. Not sure if other spots have changed much with use.

I recieved this product for free from influenster in exchange for this review! I really enjoyed using this product. The serum was very lightweight for my skin. After about a week of using this serum I noticied my dark spots becoming lighter. I would recommend

It's a little bit of a hit and miss for me. I have noticed some lightening in my dark spot. It also goes on smooth and absorbs really well. However, I have gotten some acne since starting to use this. It may just be that I'm acne prone but definitely noticed. Will start to add an acne cleanser to balance the two. I received this product for free to review.
I absolutely loved this product. Over the past few years I've noticed the spots on my face getting darker. This product worked almost immediately. I wil continue to use it!!!

I must admit this was really good. Clinique dark spot clearing serum proved its worth. This serum felt good going on plus there's a bit of spf in it to help. I love the packing and there was no scent. It played well with my other products making it easy to be consistent with. I will absolutely purchase and suggest.

avis.titre: Fragrance free serum with somewhat runny consistency.
avis.texte: The dark spot clearing serum comes in a lightweight bottle with a pump applicator. The amount of serum shown in my photo is from one pump. The serum is lightweight, but has a somewhat runny consistency. It absorbs easily, but does leave a slightly greasy residue behind. The serum is fragrance free and I didn't notice an odor at all. I didn't notice my skin being moisturized more than normal and the serum seemed to rub off easily.
I think the Packaging is sleek love the ingredients, vitamin C, and niacinamide great smooth texture rubs her nicely, but I didn't really notice a huge difference I would consider buying again
This did wonders for a few dark spots I had on my face. It didn't completely get rid of them but they did lighten it. It's basically fragrance free, soft on the skin and fits well under makeup.

I like this product but it will take some time with dark spots & older acne scars. It did help fade some of my more recent acne scars. The active ingredients are really good but I wish the other ingredients were a bit better.
This is a powerful brightening serum that's beautifully packaged! It's safe for all skin types and is best effective if you avoid the eye area. It's non scented and a lightweight texture.

I've been using the Clinique Even Better Clinical Dark Spot Serum for a few weeks now, and I really like the results! One of my favorite things about this serum is its texture—it feels lightweight and smooth, and it dries down to a matte finish without any greasiness. It layers really well under makeup, giving me a smooth, even base without any pilling or heaviness. Since incorporating it into my routine, I've noticed an improvement in my skin's texture—it feels softer. While I'm still monitoring the dark spot reduction over time, the overall feel of my skin has definitely improved. If you're looking for a serum that works well under makeup while also enhancing skin texture, this one is worth trying!
I hate to say it but this didn't work at all for me. You can see in the pictures that there is really no difference. I hope it works for someone, but for me I'll try less expensive serums next.

I was worried it would have a weird smell because of the type of product it is but it doesn't!! So that was a pleasant surprise! I've been using it for a couple days and I havent seen any results yet but I'm hopeful.

Decent scent. Overall I don't believe I would get it again. It is evening out my skin tone a very tiny amount but it doesn't appear to be doing anything on the one small dark spot I have. Smooth texture and absorbs quickly. Pretty bottle though

So far I really like the Clinique even better clinical dark spot clearing serum. I apply as directed after my moisturizer. Two little pumps goes a long way so I feel comfortable with the price point. It has little to no scent which I appreciate, especially on headache days. The application goes on smoothly and easily. I feel it helps brighten my dull, aging skin. I don't feel I have used long enough to see a big difference in dark spot correction but am hopeful for the long term. The iridescent color of the bottle is beautiful!

I love the bottle , the smell was okay ! The ingredients amazing !!! It was the perfect blend on my skin. And I'm really surprised at how well it worked , I do plan to continue to use to see how much it fades it more but I do notice it lighter !

avis.titre: Not for me, but seems like a Great product!
avis.texte: I use this product multiple times, every night, on my dark spots on my cheeks. However, I did not see a difference after a couple weeks. I know this can possibly take a while for any results to show so I will continue to use it. One thing I must know, the scent was not my favorite. Not bad, but I think they could have perfected it a little better.

I'll be honest—I don't have a lot of dark spots, but as someone with fair skin, freckles, and large pores, I'm always looking for products that improve my skin's overall tone and texture. At 51, I want a serum that truly delivers results, and Clinique Even Better Clinical Dark Spot Clearing Serum did not disappoint! From the first use, I noticed my skin looked tighter and smoother, and my pores appeared smaller—a huge win! After consistent use, my complexion became brighter and more even, giving me that fresh, youthful glow. Plus, can we talk about the packaging? The iridescent white glass bottle feels so luxe and high-end. If you want skin that looks more refined, radiant, and healthy—even if dark spots aren't your main concern—this serum is 100% worth adding to your routine.

I really wanted to love this product as it's from a well known brand. However, I feel like it didn't really do much more than a normal serum. It definitely didn't have lasting results of clearing dark spots. The bottle is sleek and I love the opalescent color.

avis.titre: We will be buying this again!
avis.texte: I gave Clinique's Even Better Clinical Dark Spot Clearing Serum to my husband, who has more sunspots, since I've been using Tretinoin. He really liked the smooth texture—it glides on easily and absorbs quickly. After a month of use, his skin feels more plumped, but he hasn't seen much improvement in his sunspots yet. The bottle has a lot of product, so he couldn't finish it within the trial period. He's hopeful that continued use will improve his hyperpigmentation, and he's interested in buying it again to see longer-term results.
packaging feel very luxurious, very heavy glass like. used the serum and it help clearing up my dark spot, definitely recommend for those looking to remove dark spot

I've been using the Clinique 302 Dark Spot Clearing Serum recently. I have combination oily skin, and I find that this serum is quite lightweight, non-sticky, and easy to apply. I've been using it for three weeks now, but I haven't seen much effect yet, especially on my dark spots, i don't see any change at all. However, it works well on acne scars, especially new ones, It's noticeablely disappearing. But I still hoping it can be effective for my dark spots.

avis.titre: Significantly Reduced Redness I Had From Previous Acne Flare
avis.texte: I've recently been dealing with cystic/hormonal acne on my jawline. After using this serum for a little over a month, I've noticed the redness I had from previous acne flare-ups is gone. This serum has worked more effectively than other serums I had been using to get rid of the redness.

avis.titre: Great choice if you want fast results
avis.texte: This serum delivers impressive results! In just a few uses, my skin looked more even, and dark spots started fading. The lightweight, smooth texture absorbs quickly without feeling greasy. It's easy to apply and has a pleasant, light scent. After consistent use, my complexion appears brighter and more uniform. If you're looking for an effective dark spot corrector that works fast, this is a great choice!

avis.titre: Didn't help with my post-acne spots
avis.texte: I received this product free in exchange for my review. I had really hoped this would help my dark spots and uneven skin tone but sadly it didn't do anything to change them. I used it daily but still did not see any improvement. It at least didn't irritate my skin since I have sensitive skin. It doesn't have a harsh scent and the bottle dispensed the product well. But I wished it could have at least diminished the appearance of my stubborn post acne spots but it didn't help.

This serum is my new holy grail as far as incorporating the vitamin C into my routine goes. It contains no irritating fragrance, the texture is incredibly smooth, and it absorbs in no time at all. I've layered multiple various products over it with no issues (no peeling). You do need to use a moisturizer over it, though. My skin showed no signs of irritation while using this (twice a day for over a month now). I am starting to see significant progress on my acne scars: lightening and fading. Plus, the glow I get from this makes me feel good and confident overall.

I have been using this product consistently for about a month now. I haven't noticed a change, but that is typically what I expect from products like this. Overall the texture is gel like, similar to a light moisturizer. I will continue to use to see if this changes over the next few months! It does however get bonus points plus for looking cute on my shelf lol.

avis.titre: Serum provides lit from within glow and reduced redness
avis.texte: I've been using this product for the past 3 weeks and began to notice a difference about 10 days in. I usually struggle with redness, uneven skin tone and dryness. This serum has provided a "lit from within" glow to my complexion, improved radiance and a more general evenness to my skin tone with no redness or irritation. Overall impressed with this product, the packaging is super cute and look forward to buying more from this line. Great serum! Incentivized review.

I was really surprised how much I like this serum. I am very picky with skincare and have spent years perfecting my routine. I added this step in the winter hoping it would help with dryness and was impressed with it's performance. I applied it twice daily for a month and noticed visible improvement to my skin texture and tone. It also helped with dry patches around my nose and mouth. The texture of the serum is silky and medium viscosity, I prefer the the thick consistency in the winter but will look for thinner products in the summer. The bottle also dispenses evenly every time, the packaging is very lux. My skin tone looks more even than it did a month ago. I will purchase another bottle when this runs out, and continue using through the fall and winter months. Over all, I would definitely recommend this serum. I received this product for free for an honest review.

I have dark spots on my face from popping pimples and I also have dark spots under my chin from plucking hair. I've noticed a slight change in the dark spots under my chin but this serum worked wonders on the dark spots I have from popping pimples. I've gotten compliments that my skin looks more refreshed these days! I love it! I also notice a change in the texture of my skin. I feel with more time, I can further lighten the underchin spots.

I've been using this for about a month and have definitely seen my sun spots lighten up. There has been some visible difference to the brightness of my skin and a more even skin tone. The serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly. There's really no fragrance or noticeable smell. Nice packaging and like the pump option for this serum. Overall, very please with this product.

avis.titre: Great serum for my skin routine
avis.texte: I've been using this Clinique serum for a month now, so it's still too early to say how effective it is on dark spots. However, I've had a great experience so far! I love the product because it doesn't have an overpowering scent. It absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky residue, making it a great addition to my skincare routine before moisturizing.

Clinique products have always been a hit and miss for me, and this one ranks as average. I don't have any apparent spots that I'm treating, so this is based on its illumining and brightening qualities which I found to be unremarkable. My skin is sensitive in the winter and within a few uses, this left me with some redness.
This is my first time using a dark spot treatment serum! I like that there is no scent in the product and that the bottle contains a decent amount of product.

avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for this review. This product is overall pretty great, I use it after cleaning my skin and before moisturizer. The smell is super mild and light, and the consistency is nice, not goopy but not like water. The packaging is beautiful as well. While I didn't really notice any long term effects in the short period I've used this product, I will say the serum has an immediate blurring effect due to the formula. I imagine this would be great as a primer/skincare double duty product. I imagine it may take longer to see noticeable results, but the product is refreshing and simple to use so I don't mind.

I love this serum. As my skin ages in my late 30's I have more difficulty with even skin tone. This lightweight easy to absorb serum is helping even out my skin tone beautifully. The packaging is so pretty, I love the iridescent bottle and the easy to use pump.
